title: Dodging Proteus: data and analysis code
description: Experiment harness, analysis, and independent-verification code, plus lightweight trial-level data, for the preprint "Dodging Proteus: Prescribing unexploitable play made language models more exploitable in a closed-loop matching pennies assay" (https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21781962). The full raw session corpus, the compiled workbook, and the reasoning-trace audit package are archived separately on OSF (https://doi.org/10.17605/OSF.IO/FM8SP).

creators.name: Martin, Christopher Flynn
creators.affiliation: Indianapolis Zoological Society; Indiana University Luddy School of Informatics, Computing, and Engineering
